Kuber · Web v1

Web v1 · Home

Home in Kuber Signature light and dark at 1440, 834 and 390. Live HTML mockups in the hero (Home) and Themes (History) are drawn from tokens and recolor with the theme; feature images are the PNGs in web-v1/mockups. Why Kuber stages are the Home v3.3 storyboard rest frames (page 1 shows its static frame). Mobile FAB is fixed to the viewport; it is drawn at the bottom of the first screen.

H1

Home · desktop 1440

Order: hero, trust strip, Why Kuber (5 parts), Signature features, Themes, Numbers, Banks, Made by one developer, final call to action, footer. Reviews are designed but hidden (H4). Handoff: the five Why Kuber parts must animate as the visitor scrolls, the same storyboard as the in-app tour (Home v3.3); the frames here are their rest states. See motion.md, Why Kuber. Signature cards show no Free / Pro badge (Beta only). Numbers checked against the app code.

The features people switch for

auto_awesomeBeta

Ask Kuber

Ask about your money in plain words and get answers right on your phone. Or describe a transaction and Kuber drafts it for you to confirm.

Free: 5 questions a week. Pro: unlimited.

Learn morearrow_forward
sms

SMS Import

Turn bank and payment SMS into transactions, parsed on your phone and imported only when you say so.

Free: 5 imports a week. Pro: unlimited.

Learn morearrow_forward
credit_card

Kuber Cards

Store card details encrypted on your phone, hidden behind biometrics. No network, ever.

Free: 2 cards. Pro: unlimited.

Learn morearrow_forward
sticky_note_2

Kuber Notes

A smart notepad that does the math. Type 'total' or '=' to add up, and tap a number to log it as a transaction, loan or ledger entry.

Free: 2 notes. Pro: unlimited.

Learn morearrow_forward
micBeta

Voice Quick Add

Say what you spent and Kuber logs it. Built into Quick Add for hands-free tracking.

Learn morearrow_forward
